wrapper.env_file: hub-wrapper/.env (gitignored, holds AGENT_WRAPPER_API_KEY, MASTRA_AGENT_URL, GISKARD_HUB_API_KEY, GISKARD_HUB_BASE_URL, GISKARD_HUB_PROJECT_ID)

tunnel.note: URL is random and changes every restart — not persisted here. Local resolver may take ~10-20s to propagate a fresh *.trycloudflare.com hostname; retry before assuming failure.

notes: Wrapper extracts only the latest user message and forwards threadId/resourceId to Mastra's own memory (LibSQL) rather than replaying full history. Mastra dev server binds to ::1 (IPv6) only, not 127.0.0.1 — use 'localhost' or '::1' as the target host, not 127.0.0.1.
